explanation: Let G=f_yz. Continuity of the higher partial derivatives allows their order to be exchanged, so the requested sum is G_y+G_z. We have G_y=6y sin(xz)+6xyz cos(xz)-3x^3z^2 sin(xy), giving 6π at (π,-1,1). Also G_z=6xy^2 cos(xz)-3x^2y^2z sin(xz)+6x^2z cos(xy), giving -6π-6π². Their sum is -6π².
